description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则且关联了增强功能套餐的DDoS高防实例。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name, and the domain name must be associated with an instance that uses the Enhanced function plan. You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

description.zh:
静态页面缓存的模式。取值：
- **standard**：标准模式
- **aggressive**：强力模式
- **bypass**：不缓存
description.en:
The cache mode of the Static Page Caching policy. Valid values:

*   **standard**: uses the standard cache mode.
*   **aggressive**: uses the enhanced cache mode.
*   **bypass**: caches no data.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 设置网站业务静态页面缓存的缓存模式

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-cache-mode --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --biz-mode standard --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo ModifyWebCacheMode --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId default --Mode standard --Domain 'www.aliyun.com'
